anya: quick async standup — short status and a repro ping
anya: what I did: ran overnight batch evals on synthia-v2 (llama3-xxlq variant) against the spanish promptset, looked for generation collapse/regressions
anya: observed multi-token collapse on ~3% of tests after quant/pack change. attached minimal sample in thread below.
anya: blockers: can't reliably repro locally, seems infra-related (KV warmup or cache eviction?) — need someone to sanity-check GPU runtime flags and a fresh cold-kv run
liam: can you paste the sample output + experiment id? I'll kick off a cold-run on dedicated infra. :eyes:
anya: sample: "Hola..." repeated then model emits a repeating token sequence. exp id `exp-2026-03-15-ankle-77`
anya: local command I used: `python -m experiments.run --model=llama3-xxlq --quant=tinyq --promptset=es_v2 --exp=exp-2026-03-15-ankle-77 --temp=0.7`
liam: thanks. on it. quick check: are you using `--kv-cache-reinit=true`? if not, try `--kv-cache-reinit=full` to force warmup path. we saw similar noise when warmup packets were skipped.
jun: FYI I pushed a promptset tweak earlier (commit 7d9a3b2) that normalizes trailing punctuation in the spanish set. unlikely to cause collapse but worth ruling out.
maria: I'll run a small eval on darwin-dedicated (2xA100) in the next hour and post logs. if liam needs a hand flipping flags I can help. :thumbsup:
liam: kicking cold-run now against `exp-2026-03-15-ankle-77` with `--kv-cache-reinit=full` + `--batch-size=1` to avoid packing. will report back in ~15m. deploy-bot: canary deployment note?
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary roll for `llama3-xxlq-tinyq` scheduled at 2026-03-15T14:12Z, will not affect dedicated infra.
anya: thanks. follow-ups: if cold-run reproduces, we'll try disabling prefix caching and compare token-by-token. if not, we'll pair-debug infra flags.
jun: pinging @maria for logs once you have them, I can diff tokenization traces.
maria: noted — posting logs here when done. quick ask: anyone on call for an hour after results to triage?
liam: I can be around. anya, want to pair after my run?
anya: yes please. will be available. thx all :heart:
